intro.text: The second king of House Lekal's realm in the Southern Dominance, and the uncle of Jastes Lekal.

items.text: After Jastes was executed for raising a koloss army he could not control, Audil took charge of the southern lands House Lekal had claimed. He ruled them from Lekal City, a former country estate that had turned into a shantytown amid the turmoil that followed the Lord Ruler's death.
Breeze and Sazed came to him on Elend's behalf so that he would sign a treaty submitting to Elend's rule. After they had waited a while, one of the king's aides brought them the signed document.
As Scadrial came apart, lava from an ashmount swept over his kingdom, and Audil died with it.
